title: Energy-normalized wave--Klein--Gordon null cancellation is same-tier on the nonzero torus modes

normalized_bound.torus_bound: For p in Z^3 minus zero and M>0, |p|>=1 and omega(k)>=M, so M0<=1+1/M uniformly in p and k
normalized_bound.interpretation: The normalized null form removes the small divisor without derivative loss on the declared branch
normalized_bound.nonlocal_price: The normalization contains |nabla|^(-1) and omega(D)^(-1); it is not the local spatial current appearing in K1413
normalized_bound.ceiling: No bilinear spacetime estimate, nonlinear composition, charge summation, radial-leakage control or global flow is constructed
